_meta.description: Live Bay Area sports radio beyond the three requested sections: Golden State Warriors (NBA) and Golden State Valkyries (WNBA) on KGMZ 95.7 The Game, plus researched exclusions. Per the user's request, other sports broadcast live over AM/FM radio in the Bay Area are flagged HIGH priority and count as busy -- but only in the 'Everything tracked' (all) scope, so the three requested section definitions stay exactly as written. Streaming-only broadcasts (Sharks Audio Network, Audacy-only Valkyries games) are NOT counted as busy: the user's definition is a standard AM/FM radio in Outer Sunset 94122.

_meta.time_semantics: start_et is the published tip-off in Eastern Time (CBS Sports schedule grids publish ET). The loader converts to UTC exactly like the Westwood One rows. Where a source publishes Pacific wall-clock times (Valkyries), start_pt is used instead.

counting_rules.blocking: A game blocks (marks time not-free) only when an AM/FM broadcast serving San Francisco is verified or strongly evidenced. Valkyries games whose radio column is 'The Audacy App' only are streaming-only and do NOT block; they are disclosed instead.
counting_rules.priority: high for every team in this file that blocks (user's rule: other live-radio Bay Area sports are high priority like the Giants and 49ers).
counting_rules.scope: tags NBA:Warriors / WNBA:Valkyries match no section in profiles.json, so these games belong to the 'all' scope only and are shown to Sections 1-3 users as outside-their-situation disclosures.

duration_basis.NBA: 150 minutes (2:30). Secondary timing references put the 2025-26 NBA tip-to-buzzer average near 2:18-2:19 (2h18m32s aggregated figure) with typical 2h15 lengths; 150 is a conservative planning length like the other leagues. Sources: https://sportsgeardaily.com/basketball/how-long-are-basketball-games (2026-05-02), https://www.alibaba.com/product-insights/how-long-is-the-average-basketball-game-2026-guide.html (2026-03-10).
duration_basis.WNBA: 120 minutes (2:00). Secondary references give 1:45-2:00 tip-to-buzzer for a 40-minute game. Sources: https://sportsmonkie.com/how-long-are-wnba-games/, https://www.gametimehero.com/blog/how-long-is-a-wnba-game, https://opensourcesports.io/rules/basketball-wnba/rules-of-play-game-duration. Planning estimates, not verified current-season league averages.
